hooks.command: cd /home/user/test || exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && exit 0; npm run test:run >/tmp/claude-vitest-stop.log 2>&1 || printf '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ vitest failed on Stop — run: npm run test:run (log:/tmp/claude-vitest-stop.log)"}'

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && exit 0; npm run lint >/tmp/claude-eslint-stop.log 2>&1 || printf '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ eslint failed on Stop — run: npm run lint (log:/tmp/claude-eslint-stop.log)"}'
